cards.mood: The piece opens with a fragile, introspective melancholy, establishing a sense of delicate stillness.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the sole harmonic and melodic foundation, playing a flowing, arpeggiated pattern that persists from the Intro through to the Outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dust motes dance in the hallway light
Tracing the edges of the coming night
A single chair holds a ghost of grace
Time slows down in this hollow space
[Pre-Chorus]
Whispers are blooming like winter flowers
Quietly weaving through the passing hours
[Chorus]
Fragile as glass in a steady hand
Soft as the tide on a silver strand
Every heartbeat is a secret told
Turning the copper into thread of gold
[Verse]
The garden sleeps in a velvet fold
Stories of the morning wait to be told
A window pane holds the weeping rain
Healing the cracks and the hidden pain
[Pre-Chorus]
The shadows stretch across the floor
Opening every long-locked door
[Chorus]
Fragile as glass in a steady hand
Soft as the tide on a silver strand
Every heartbeat is a secret told
Turning the copper into thread of gold
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
A breath caught in the morning haze
Finding the path through the ancient maze
[Chorus]
Fragile as glass in a steady hand
Soft as the tide on a silver strand
Every heartbeat is a secret told
Turning the copper into thread of gold
[Outro]
